description: Find UK Acts and regulations by words of their title, or by id (e.g. ukpga/1996/18). Exact titles, Acts and laws in force come first. Returns id, title, status, extent and topics.

extent.description: Only laws that extend to E, W, S or N.I.

query.description: Words from the title, e.g. "employment rights act", or an id such as "ukpga/2018/12"

topic.description: Only laws under a topic whose name contains this text, e.g. Housing

types.description: Only these id prefixes: ukpga (UK Acts), uksi (UK regulations), asp/ssi (Scotland), asc/anaw/wsi (Wales), nia/nisr (Northern Ireland), eur (EU-origin)

name: search_laws
title: Search UK laws
